title: Opposed Fractured Frozen Riverbanks
description: One static frozen-riverbank cutaway scene. Two complete unchanged thick undercut fractured ice-edge assets face one another across a genuinely empty narrow bank-to-bank gap, above a flat opaque blue frozen-river base. Two whole snowbank modules sit on scene-only raised north and south ground strips; their ground-strip tops align with the full ice-edge upper surfaces. Four whole rigid unit-scale instances of two published models, one scene preset and zero new independent models. Not the old flowing woodland stream recolored: no stream meshes, rocks, fungi or trees are imported, and the wide fractured ice shelves, genuine V notches and deep underside ledges remain intact. No flowing water, weather, ice strength, walking route, load or safety certification.
